map.流程图绘制工具基于开源图表引擎 Mermaid，通过编写简洁的文本代码即可生成专: The flowchart drawing tool is built on the open-source diagram engine Mermaid and generates professional, polished diagrams from concise text code. It supports seven common diagram types - flowchart, sequence diagram, Gantt chart, class diagram, state diagram, ER diagram and pie chart. You edit the code on the left and see a live preview on the right for WYSIWYG results, and can export SVG vector graphics or PNG images with one click. All computation and rendering happen locally in your browser, so no data is uploaded and your work stays private.

map.准备项目汇报材料时，用架构图/类图表达模块关系，一键切换七种图表类型后导出图片插: When preparing a project report, use architecture or class diagrams to express module relationships, switch among the seven diagram types and export an image to drop into your document.
map.示例：用 Mermaid 语法画一张判断流程图: Example: draw a decision flowchart with Mermaid syntax
map.输入：\ngraph TD\n A[开始] --> B{条件判断}\n B:
Input:
graph TD
  A[Start] --> B{Decision}
  B -->|Yes| C[Process]
  B -->|No| D[End]
The page renders in real time (500ms debounce); once it looks right, click "Export SVG / PNG" to get a vector or raster image.
map.内置七种图表类型可一键切换，涵盖流程图、时序图、类图、状态图等常见结构，切换后自: Seven built-in diagram types can be switched with one click, covering flowchart, sequence diagram, class diagram, state diagram and other common structures, and each switch re-renders with the matching syntax.
map.编辑内容自动保存到浏览器本地，刷新页面不会丢失；导出时支持 SVG（矢量、可二次: Edits are auto-saved to local browser storage, so refreshing the page loses nothing; export supports both SVG (vector, editable afterwards) and PNG (raster).
